svg.title: Compare and what-if wireframe
svg.text: Baseline versus modified, with line-item deltas.
Baseline: retire at 60 · Modified: retire at 55
Changing any input reruns the projection against the saved
Same overlay, saved plans on both sides.
What-if overlays a modified line on the saved baseline. The baseline is dashed and never mutated by previewing.
Deltas are line items from the API. Lowering retirement age from 60 to 55 adds $412,000 of net worth at 85 in this
Keep changes saves the modified plan; Revert restores retirement age 60 and discards the overlay.
Two saved plans use the same overlay, so a plan-to-plan comparison and a what-if comparison behave identically.
